metric.name: startup_ttid_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.startups;
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.time_to_display;
WITH
  cold AS (
    SELECT s.package, d.time_to_initial_display AS ns
    FROM android_startups AS s
    JOIN android_startup_time_to_display AS d USING (startup_id)
    WHERE s.startup_type = 'cold'
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT package FROM cold GROUP BY package ORDER BY count(*) DESC, package LIMIT 1
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ns) AS rank, count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM cold
    WHERE package = (SELECT package FROM app) AND ns IS NOT NULL
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n + 1) / 2) AS value

claims.text: The startup rows identify com.superplayer.demo and contain 20 cold starts in each trace, so the selected metric is measuring the demo app rather than an unrelated package.

INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.startups;
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.time_to_display;
SELECT s.package, s.startup_id, s.startup_type, s.ts,
       d.time_to_initial_display / 1e6 AS ttid_ms,
       d.time_to_full_display / 1e6 AS ttfd_ms
FROM android_startups AS s
JOIN android_startup_time_to_display AS d USING (startup_id)
WHERE s.startup_type = 'cold'
ORDER BY s.package, s.ts

claims.text: The range contains no trace-supported startup regression to attribute. The head commit changes FeedScreen only by renaming the feed handler field and its call site, and the blamed lines are the rename itself rather than a new startup operation.

caveats: This conclusion is based on one baseline/current capture pair, so run-to-run variability cannot be ruled out.
The captures were made on an emulator benchmark build; startup medians reduce but do not eliminate capture noise.

dropped_claims.text: Median cold-start time to initial display improved from 425.901458 ms in the baseline to 386.763334 ms in the current trace, a delta of -39.138124 ms.
